scope: Four purposively selected mature Apache projects and release versions not used in development. Capture all results of the frozen project-dev-list version+VOTE query and the frozen portable tag namespace. Include every identified opening for the target software/version even if the parser emits nothing. Do not replace projects after observing coverage. This is internal prospective ordering, not public registration.
assistance: After running the unchanged extractor, inspect full mail to enumerate openings, conclusions and explicitly designated tags. At most one operation per unresolved opening: supply a captured conclusion URL and its explicit disposition to an already correctly object-bound motion. Opening repairs and guesses about repository convention are excluded. Preserve unresolved and absent closing evidence; conservative false reuse comparison only for decidable source-inspected cases. A negative requires an explicit withdrawal/failure message; silence stays unknown. No participant or time estimate.
final_tag: Use the prespecified final tag for automatic evaluation. If absent, retain the missing pin; any conventional equivalent found in the raw namespace is descriptive only.
outcome_counts: Report family, indexed-message and manually inspected opening denominators separately. Report automatic versus assisted determinate handoffs and residual gaps including no record. Confirmed negative closes the request without a source match. Formal outcome-equivalence remains contingent on named tag stability unless the opening independently states the OID.
